title: DeepSeek open-sourced an agent that runs your repo
caption:
DeepSeek open-sourced dsh-superagent: an agent that listens to one GitHub repo, opens its own work items, works in its own session and answers with pull requests. 21k stars in about a week. Research prototype, MIT licensed.

Repo: github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype

scenes.narration: DeepSeek just open-sourced an agent that runs your GitHub repo on its own. 21 thousand stars in about a week.
scenes.title: An agent that runs your repo.

scenes.narration: It listens to your repo. When someone allowed asks for work, it opens a work item, does the job in its own session, and replies with a pull request.
scenes.title: What it actually does
lines: Listens to GitHub issues and comments
Opens a work item per request
Works in its own session and directory

scenes.narration: Request in. Work item. Agent session. Pull request out. A panel shows only what a human still has to decide.
scenes.title: Request in, pull request out

scenes.narration: Setup is done by another agent: ask your coding agent to read SETUP dot M D, it asks one question at a time, then installs everything.
scenes.title: Set up by an agent, for an agent

lines.text: > Read SETUP.md and set up dsh-superagent with me
agent: one question at a time, then the full plan
pnpm check   typecheck ok   tests ok   build ok

scenes.narration: The rule is attention. It acts only when asked or allowed by a team rule, and speaks only when someone must act.
scenes.title: Minimum attention, maximum value
lines: Acts only when asked or allowed by a team rule
Speaks only when a human must act
Take little attention, give much value

scenes.narration: MIT licensed, built for the DeepSeek Harness, and labelled a research prototype, not a product. Try it on a repo you can afford to break.
scenes.title: Research prototype. MIT. Open.
scenes.cta: Follow for one AI tool a day
